title: Compound Prefix
editorialSummary: 16 word-endings each form a real compound with exactly one of OVER/UNDER/CROSS/OUT. Compounds: OVERTURE/OVERBEARING/OVERJOYED/OVERSIGHT, UNDERBELLY/UNDERPINNING/UNDERTOW/UNDERMINE, CROSSROADS/CROSSBOW/CROSSWIND/CROSSCHECK, OUTRAGE/OUTSKIRTS/OUTSPOKEN/OUTSHINE. Every assignment is uniquely provable.

meta.gptRationale: The mechanic is simple, yet many completions are not equally common compounds, so solvers need precise lexical recall rather than broad theme recognition.
